name: nd5w rejectionHandled fires after the late handler runs
source: function main(): void { process.on("unhandledRejection", (r: any) => { console.log("UR:", r); }); process.on("rejectionHandled", () => console.log("RH")); const p = Promise.reject("late"); setTimeout(() => p.catch(() => console.log("caught late")), 5); setTimeout(() => {}, 20); }
